_doc: Two ways to place dealership vehicle spawn points (MTDealerVehicleSpawnPoint). (1) IN-EDITOR: place a placeholder named 'Dealership_<VehicleKey>' (split on the FIRST underscore, so keys with underscores like Cotra_20_3L survive); import_meshes resolves the vehicle path from the extracted game content, offsets it like other meshes, and the placeholder's own mesh is NOT shipped. (2) HAND-AUTHORED: list entries in the groups below. Both feed map_work_changes.json['dealerships'] which convert2.py injects. Coords are editor-local and get the world offset (MTMI_OFFSET_*); set 'world_coords': true to take X/Y/Z/Pitch/Roll/Yaw verbatim. Group/entry names starting with '_' are ignored (notes/examples). vehicle_path is the cooked vehicle BP path; vehicle_key its short asset name.
